Address-space placement, translation and TLB effects of image and device-tree constants are not shown.

Contention retry bounds and fairness for exclusive accesses are not shown.

findings.text: Offers a wide atomic compare exchange that divides expected and desired values into lower and upper halves, attempts replacement at a caller pointer, and reports the contents seen during the attempt with ordering chosen by the caller variant.
Supplies event signalling plus suspend until event or interrupt, including timed wait forms that program system time controls, all acting as compiler ordering points.

Exposes fine-grained ordering hints for data barrier by option, trace and consumption ordering, global synchronization acknowledgement, and a speculation barrier that resolves at boot to either a barrier pair or a dedicated instruction.
Provides an interrupt priority mask sync operation with a barrier form patched to no-ops on capable hardware and an empty form when the feature is unavailable.
Defines full, read and write barriers, outer shareable DMA barriers, a write-combining stop, and a trace sync that repeats the barrier on CPUs flagged for flush failure and otherwise issues it once.
Yields an all-ones mask when an index is inside its bound and zero when outside, followed by a consumption ordering step so later speculative uses are constrained.

Implements inner shareable barriers, sized release stores and acquire loads for narrow and wide scalars with type and sanitizer checks, and two polling helpers that re-read relaxed or acquire until a caller predicate succeeds, waiting on unchanged values between reads.
Reverses bit order in a word with dedicated hardware support and obtains narrower reversals by reusing the wide reversal and discarding low bits.

Reports whether the instruction cache may alias, reads cache type identification, derives coherency width and per-CPU line size with a DMA minimum fallback, aliases DMA alignment to line size, and completes DMA flush with a full barrier.

Compacts affinity-based identifiers by keeping low bits and top affinity level while rejecting inputs with nonzero reserved high range, and synthesizes an effective cache type that advertises clean-to-unification support when level reporting shows no outer cache.
Chooses slab minimum alignment from memory tagging granule when hardware tagging is enabled and from natural wide alignment otherwise.
Assembly routine that cleans and invalidates caches to point of unification for a caller range and then returns.

Flushes a virtual range to point of unification, bypasses cross-CPU notification when running as debugger master, otherwise asks all CPUs to synchronize, and offers a global invalidate that is skipped when hardware reports data-cache clean support.

Folds accumulated sums to short form by merging halves and complementing, speeds IPv4 header sums by handling the leading block widely before processing trailing words, and advertises arch ownership of IPv6 and generic sum helpers.

Provides atomic exchange and compare exchange for one, two, four and eight byte objects with relaxed, acquire, release and full orderings, dispatching on object width and rejecting other widths at build time, with local compare exchange matching relaxed.
Declares wide compare exchange as always available with full and local forms, and offers sized wait-on-value helpers that briefly sleep and recheck until the observed value changes.
Triggers a breakpoint-based fatal trap that does not return and a warning form that marks the trap with warning flags.
Each header guards against multiple inclusion with a unique macro defined on first entry.

Emits a caller-requested count of no-operations, leaves the BPF call annotation empty, and self-identifies arch ownership for copy to user, generic sum, range flush, folio flush, compact id and checksum fold helpers.
Boot layout requires device tree alignment of eight, device tree size cap of two megabytes, and kernel image alignment of two megabytes.

Debug immediates assign four through seven to probe paths, two hundred fifty-six to fault, one thousand twenty-four and one thousand twenty-five to debugger, two thousand forty-eight to bug, twenty-three hundred four with low-byte mask to kasan, twenty-one thousand seven hundred sixty with low-byte mask to ubsan, and a high base with five-bit target plus five-bit type fields to integrity checks.

Cache and allocation geometry fixes level-one shift at six for sixty-four bytes, DMA minimum at one hundred twenty-eight, malloc minimum at eight, slab shadow minimum scaling with kasan, alias flag at index zero, dcache-clean page flag aliasing first arch flag, and folio flush support advertised as present.

Level decoding extracts three-bit fields at shifts twenty-seven, twenty-four and twenty-one, per-level cache type uses three times level minus one, and tag type uses twice level minus one plus a system base.
Compatibility mode, user and group ids and IPC pids are sixteen-bit, statfs uses the compat form, and machine names report big-endian and little-endian ARMv8 variants padded to eight bytes.
Only narrow and wide scalar widths are accepted for exchange and wait paths, ordering is preserved from caller choice, and sixty-four-bit compare exchange aliases the generic width-dispatched form.

Effective cache type gains clean capability only when hardware type lacks it and level fields show no outer cache, and compacted ids keep low twenty-four bits plus top affinity while failing closed on reserved high bits.
Index masking is inseparable from its trailing consumption ordering, and trace ordering is single except on flagged CPUs where it is doubled while staying in prohibited trace state.
Wide atomics view one hundred twenty-eight bits as low plus high sixty-four-bit lanes for transfer, and SMP accessors stage through a scalar-or-bytes view to select width-specific handling.
Exchange without large-system-extension support loops between observe and conditional store until the store succeeds, while capable hardware completes the same logical transition in one step.
Conditional loading cycles through observe, test caller condition, exit on success, and wait-then-reobserve on failure.
Range maintenance proceeds from local clean to debugger check to global synchronization, taking an early completion path under debugger control and a broadcast path otherwise.

Requesting cross-CPU sync from debugger master risks deadlock, skipping the second trace barrier on affected parts risks stale trace, and missing consumption ordering or post-patch synchronization risks speculative or stale execution.
